verdict: Leads are coming in; the pipeline gap is the priority to close now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 172 leads from Meta at $12.35 per lead — a solid volume number — but the last 7 days showed an 18% drop in leads with cost per lead rising 22% on nearly flat spend, a pattern consistent with the ad creative running without rotation for roughly 45 days. At the same time, your CRM shows 144 contacts against 172 platform-reported leads, and zero opportunities have been created in the pipeline this period, which means the lead flow issue is less about the ads and more about what happens after a lead arrives. Ad creative is being refreshed this week to address the efficiency slide, and intake automation is being prioritised to close the gap between leads received and leads worked.

highlights.phrase: leads received from Meta in the last 28 days
cost per lead this period, up 22% in the most recent 7 days
pipeline opportunities created from those leads this period

watch_item.issue: Leads are arriving but not moving into your pipeline — 172 received, zero opportunities created this period.
watch_item.fix: Intake automation is being activated now to ensure every lead is logged, routed, and followed up without manual gaps.
